claims.statement: The Commission stated in July 2026 that EUDR application would begin at the end of December 2026 under the revised timetable.
The Commission launched the EUDR Information System for submission of due-diligence statements.

contrary_evidence: Recent simplifications and delays reduce urgency for some small firms.
Generic EUDR software vendors already compete for importer budgets.

economics.acquisition_route: Unvalidated hypothesis: sell through customs brokers, furniture clusters, and trade-finance advisers.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Unvalidated hypothesis: 2,000 importers and a reusable cross-border supplier graph could support a 5 million PLN founder net-worth path in eight to eleven years.
economics.founder_time: Unvalidated hypothesis: automated document and geospatial checks keep founder work below 20 hours weekly.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Unvalidated hypothesis: evidence reuse could reach 70% gross margin, and every commercial number including capital_required_pln is hypothetical.
economics.payback: Unvalidated hypothesis: acquisition pays back after 25 covered shipments.
economics.pricing: Unvalidated hypothesis: charge 180 PLN per shipment plus 800 PLN per active supplier yearly.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Unvalidated hypothesis: recurring imports and shared suppliers create repeat transactions.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A supplier-to-plot evidence graph amortizes verification and exposes shared upstream risk
fingerprint.customer: Polish furniture, wood, and paper importers with fragmented suppliers
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Customs-broker referrals and regional furniture-cluster partnerships
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Permissioned evidence vault, supplier risk review, and per-shipment compliance packet
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The importer pays when a supplier is verified and a shipment packet is produced
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A covered shipment approaches market entry without reusable due-diligence evidence

founder_fit: Geospatial risk scoring and document automation fit the founder's technical profile.
Broker-led distribution avoids constant public-facing selling.
risks: Supplier fraud or bad coordinates could defeat automated checks.
Holding sensitive supplier evidence creates security and contractual exposure.

structure.commercial_archetype: Supply-chain evidence escrow and risk graph
structure.control_point: Verified supplier plot record reused at each covered shipment
structure.critical_dependency: Reliable upstream geolocation evidence and stable Information System integration

thesis: Hold reusable supplier geolocation evidence and due-diligence references for small furniture and wood-product importers.
title: EUDR Supplier Evidence Escrow
uncertainties: Importer payment behavior before enforcement is unverified.
All commercial numbers including capital_required_pln are unvalidated hypotheses.
